title: Proration of the Release Forfeit — Homesite Reservation
content:
On the release of a Homesite Reservation after the full-refund window, the release forfeit is drawn from the unadjusted forfeit (the premium holding fee received less the refundable share) according to the number of extensions written on the reservation, as its record shows.

| Extensions written on the reservation | Release forfeit |
|---|---|
| none | the unadjusted forfeit prorated by the hold already run: multiplied by the calendar days from the reservation date to the release date and divided by the calendar days from the reservation date to the hold expiry date, rounded half up to the cent |
| exactly one | the unadjusted forfeit prorated the same way but rounded down to the cent, and never below half of the unadjusted forfeit, that half rounded half up to the cent |
| more than one | the unadjusted forfeit, kept whole |

## Worked cases (hypothetical unadjusted forfeit of 600.00, reservation dated 1 June, release on 7 June)

| Extensions | Hold expiry date | Proration | Release forfeit |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | 11 June | 600.00 multiplied by 6 and divided by 10 is 360.00 | 360.00 |
| exactly one | 18 June | 600.00 multiplied by 6 and divided by 17 is 211.76 rounded down; half of 600.00 is 300.00 | 300.00 |
| exactly one, release on 16 June instead | 18 June | 600.00 multiplied by 15 and divided by 17 is 529.41 rounded down; above 300.00 | 529.41 |
| two | any | none | 600.00 |
